item.text: I'll start by inspecting each of the four assigned locators to understand what evidence is available before recording any claims.

All four locators inspected successfully. Now I'll extract atomic factual intents from the inspected passages. Note that the source material is primarily from the 2017-2018 campaign period, not the 2022 in-rule evaluation year. I need to be careful: the chapter asks about what the ruler did during their rule; much of this content is pre-rule campaign pledges and only partially in-period. I'll record only materially distinct facts and split non-contiguous support.

Let me identify distinct facts by locator:

**Locator 60** (S00001-S00005): The Proyecto Alternativo de Nación 2018-2024 was presented on 20 November 2017 at MORENA's IV Congress; it was a base document open to scrutiny; structured into four commissions and seven general guidelines including "Legalidad y erradicación de la corrupción", "Combate a la pobreza", "Recuperación de la paz", "Viabilidad financiera y austeridad", "Equidad de género", "Desarrollo sostenible y buen vivir", "Reconstrucción nacional."

**Locator 62** (S00007-S00011): "Austeridad republicana" - fiscal adjustment via current spending savings, no tax increases (some reductions in border states), no new debt; gradual minimum wage increase to 171 pesos by end of sexenio; elder pensions of 1,500 pesos monthly; increase domestic gasoline supply and refineries; reverse Peña Nieto energy reform; pursue energy and food self-sufficiency with guaranteed prices for local producers.

**Locator 63** (S00008-S00012): Platform 2018-2024 was pragmatic social democracy accepting free market principles, free trade, macroeconomic stability, fiscal discipline, peso floatation, Banco de México autonomy; but rejecting neoliberalism, privatization trends, and foreignization of strategic sectors; prioritizing national production, domestic consumption, horizontal growth.

**Locator 64** (S00001-S00004): Platform positions including rejection of grand coalition government; legal mechanisms for mandate revocation; free Internet nationwide; closing gender labor gaps; Jóvenes Construyendo el Futuro student scholarship program; Santa Lucía airport instead of NAIM.

Let me record these. I'll start with the most relevant campaign-platform content for the economic wellbeing chapter.
